text: This guide explains how to make a copy of your apartment keys in Germany.

When youmove in, you must get at least two sets of keys. If more people live together, each person must get a set of keys. Older children also get a set of keys. Each set of keys must include the building key, the apartment key and the mailbox key. You must not pay for these keys; not even a deposit.1 If you want more keys, you must pay for them.If you lost your keys, you must pay to replace them.7

title: Apartment keys
text: Regular keys open the door to your apartment. To copy them… Go to a locksmithGo to a locksmith (Schlüsseldienst) or to Bauhaus with the key you want to copy.10 Ask for a copiesMaking a key double takes a few minutes. It usually costs around €5per key. Inform your landlordYou do not need their permission to make new keys, but you must inform them.13 You can give a copy of your apartment keys to anyone you trust.5

title: Building keys
text: Building keys open the front door of your apartment building. To copy them… Get permission from your landlordYou need permission to copy building keys.4Some keys have a protected shape, and you need a code card (Sicherungskarte) or permission letter (Berechtigungsschein) to copy them. Your landlord will give this to you. Go to a locksmithIf yourHausverwaltunghas a contract with a specific locksmith, you must go to that locksmith.8These locksmiths are often very expensive.Get an unofficial copy– €5to €35Some locksmiths can replace building keys. You don’t need a code card.9It’s completely legal.2You can sendSchlüsseldienst Samuela photo of your key on WhatsApp, and they tell you if they can copy it. They speak English, French and Arabic.12Get an official copy– €30to €80Bring your permission letter or code card to the locksmith. Also bring an ID document.
